We're looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will oversee and manage projects during the pre-contract design phase, ensuring seamless coordination between design teams, clients, and stakeholders. You will be responsible for maintaining project timelines, budgets, and quality standards while navigating the unique regulatory and business environment of the UAE. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines.
Manage all aspects of projects during the pre-contract design phase, including scope definition, scheduling, and resource allocation
Coordinate with design teams, consultants, and clients to ensure alignment on project objectives and deliverables
Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including design briefs, schedules, and progress reports
Analyze design proposals and feasibility studies to identify risks, constraints, and opportunities for optimization
Monitor project budgets and costs, providing regular financial updates and recommendations for cost control
Establish and maintain clear communication channels with all stakeholders, providing regular status updates and managing expectations
Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful project progression
Ensure compliance with local UAE regulations, building codes, and industry standards throughout the design phase
Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining attention to detail and quality standards
Prepare and present project reports to senior management and clients, highlighting key milestones and performance metrics
Facilitate design reviews and meetings to resolve issues and drive decision-making processes
q: Minimum 5 years of project management experience
Bachelors degree in built environment subject. International Accreditation (MIStructeE/MICE /RIBA /AIA/PMP or equivalent preferred).
Proven expertise in managing design projects within the construction, real estate, or engineering sectors
Strong proficiency with project management tools and software (Microsoft Project, Primavera, or equivalent)
Advanced knowledge of design processes, methodologies, and industry standards
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex project variables
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, resources, and timelines effectively
Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification
Experience working in the UAE or Middle East market
Knowledge of local UAE building codes, regulations, and approval processes

d: The Senior Auto Electrician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical and electronic systems in heavy vehicles, construction equipment, and plant machinery. The role ensures vehicles and equipment are maintained in a safe, reliable, and roadworthy condition while complying with company safety and quality standards.
q: Diploma, ITI, or Technical Certificate in Auto Electrical Technology or a related field
Minimum 7-10 years of experience as an Auto Electrician, preferably in heavy vehicles, commercial fleets, or construction equipment
Experience working on trucks, buses, trailers, generators, and heavy construction machinery
Strong knowledge of automotive electrical systems, ECU diagnostics, CAN Bus systems, and fault-finding techniques
Ability to read and interpret electrical diagrams and manufacturer's manuals
r: Understand and comply with the company's Health & Safety Policy, safety procedures, emergency procedures, risk assessments, and safe working practices
Ensure all maintenance and repair activities are carried out in accordance with site safety requirements
Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and ensure compliance by colleagues and visitors within the work area
Report all safety incidents, injuries, damage, vehicle accidents, hazards, and near misses to the Workshop Supervisor and Safety Officer
Maintain high standards of housekeeping within the workshop and worksite
Participate in weekly toolbox talks and other safety-related meetings
Undertake all electrical service, maintenance, and repair activities as assigned, ensuring service records are completed accurately
Attend vehicle and equipment breakdowns and perform fault diagnosis and corrective repairs
Diagnose and repair electrical and electronic systems including wiring harnesses, batteries, starters, alternators, sensors, lighting systems, control modules, and CAN Bus systems
Use diagnostic equipment and testing instruments to identify faults and verify repairs
Complete all work safely, efficiently, and within agreed timelines
Ensure vehicles and equipment are handed back in a safe and fully operational condition
Report major defects, recurring faults, or issues that may affect vehicle safety, reliability, or performance
Read and interpret wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, and technical manuals
Carry out preventive maintenance inspections on vehicle electrical systems
Assist in training and mentoring junior Auto Electricians and workshop personnel
Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in good condition
